jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems ML: PyTorch Distributed
jobs.description:
In this role, you will be a member of the PyTorch Distributed team. The PyTorch team develops the open source software stack powering AI models and systems. The Distributed team builds the foundational infrastructure, APIs, kernels, tools, and recipes for enabling fast and reliable distributed training in PyTorch as well as in TorchTitan, the PyTorch-native framework for LLM pretraining and post-training. In this role, you will work closely with AI researchers & infrastructure engineers within Meta and from the open-source community to optimize distributed training using PyTorch. A sample of the team’s recent work is highlighted in the following blogs: TorchTitan ([https://pytorch.org/blog/torchtitan-update-new-sota-models-performance-at-scale-titanrl/](https://pytorch.org/blog/torchtitan-update-new-sota-models-performance-at-scale-titanrl/)), DistMoE ([https://meta-pytorch.org/dist\_moe/previews/visual-explainer/](https://meta-pytorch.org/dist\_moe/previews/visual-explainer/)), OLMO3 reproduction ([https://docs.pytorch.org/devlogs/distributed/2026-09-02-olmo3-reproduction/](https://docs.pytorch.org/devlogs/distributed/2026-09-02-olmo3-reproduction/)).  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Systems ML: PyTorch Distributed Responsibilities:**

* Improve PyTorch's state of the art training, post-training, and inference on modern AI hardware accelerators
* Enable new models in TorchTitan for pre-training and post-training
* Optimize the performance of TorchTitan’s pre-training and post-training of latest Gen AI models
* Develop the latest parallelism APIs, kernels, and tools for debugging/visualizing large distributed training jobs
* Build foundational distributed training infrastructure including communication collectives, profiling, memory allocation/management, etc

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
* Proven Python programming
* Experience in AI framework development or accelerating deep learning models on hardware architectures

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Knowledge of GPU, CPU, or AI hardware accelerator architectures
* Experience working with frameworks like PyTorch, Caffe2, TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* OR AI high performance kernels: Experience with CUDA programming, OpenMP / OpenCL programming or AI hardware accelerator kernel programming. Experience in accelerating libraries on AI hardware, similar to cuBLAS, cuDNN, CUTLASS, HIP, ROCm etc
* OR AI frameworks: Experience in developing training and inference framework components. Experience in system performance optimizations such as runtime analysis of latency, memory bandwidth, I/O access, compute utilization analysis and associated tooling development
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

Join Lam as a Product Engineer with expertise in Data Science and Advanced Analytics, where you'll combine hands-on semiconductor experimentation with modern analytical methods to solve complex process and hardware challenges.

  

In this role, you will work directly with process development, technology development, product engineering, and customer escalations. You will design and execute experiments, develop advanced test vehicles, analyze data from multiple sources, and apply statistical and machine learning techniques to identify root causes, optimize processes, and uncover underlying physical mechanisms.

  

Operating at the intersection of semiconductor engineering, experimental science, and data analytics, you will transform laboratory and field data into actionable insights that improve product performance, accelerate technology development, and support data-driven engineering decisions.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

This position is for a Product Engineer with Data Science specialization within the Selective Etch Product Group, part of the Global Products Group, based in Fremont, CA.

**Process Development & Engineering**

* Perform process engineering research, development, characterization, and evaluation in support of Lam's semiconductor capital equipment and systems.
* Support new technology development, product qualification, and customer deployment activities.
* Design, execute, and analyze experiments to investigate process, hardware, and system-level performance.
* Develop advanced test vehicles and apply systematic problem-solving methodologies to improve product capability and reliability.
* Compile and evaluate experimental data to establish process understanding and engineering recommendations.

**Customer Escalations & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead technical investigations associated with customer escalations by combining engineering fundamentals, experimental observations, and advanced analytics.
* Apply statistical analysis, engineering judgment, and structured root-cause methodologies to identify failure mechanisms and drive corrective actions.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to rapidly resolve product and process issues impacting customer performance.

**Data Science, AI & Advanced Analytics**

* Develop predictive models and data-driven methodologies that improve understanding of process behavior and equipment performance.
* Apply machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics techniques to laboratory, manufacturing, and field data sets.
* Develop analytics tools, automated workflows, and visualization methods that enable engineers to efficiently analyze complex datasets.
* Utilize data science methodologies to optimize experiments, improve process windows, accelerate root cause analysis, and support technology development.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Collaborate closely with process engineers, hardware engineers, systems engineers, field organizations, and customers to solve challenging technical problems.
* Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, management, and customer stakeholders.
* Contribute to building a culture of scientific rigor and data-driven decision making across the organization.

-------------------------

* PhD or Master's degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering Physics, or a related engineering or scientific discipline.

In 2024, Kodiak launched commercial Driver-as-a-Service operations with no one in the cab, and plans to launch driverless long-haul service between Dallas and Houston by the end of 2026.

jobs.title: Applied Science Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**Why Join Stand****:** At Stand, you’ll help build a new class of global property protection. We use advanced physics and AI to model catastrophic risk at the asset level, then automate underwriting and mitigation before loss occurs. Insurance is simply the current delivery mechanism. The real product is a scalable risk engine, our **Stand World Model**.

We stay when traditional insurers exit. We model what others approximate. And we build systems that change outcomes, not just prices.  
  
Our **leadership team** has built category-defining companies (Metromile, Policygenius, WePay, HotelTonight) and brings decades of expertise in underwriting, capital management, and reinsurance.

**Background:** The property insurance industry is built to price loss after it happens. It relies on coarse proxies, backward-looking data, and manual processes, then accepts damage as unavoidable.

Stand takes a different approach. We simulate how real-world catastrophes affect individual properties, translate that into actionable decisions, and automate the business around it. The result is a platform that can underwrite what others can’t and operate with far less friction.

**Role Summary:**

As an **Applied Science Platform Engineer**, you will build and run the systems that take Stand's physics simulations, digital twins, AI/ML models, and spatial intelligence from research code to reliable production. Your work spans simulation pipelines, AI training and inference infrastructure, geospatial data processing, annotation and QC systems, and CI/CD.

You will own pipelines end to end: design, build, deploy, monitor, and fix. Reporting to the Applied Science Platform Lead, you will partner with Physics Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers (MLEs), and peril subject matter experts (SMEs) to turn their needs into platform capabilities, and to extend the platform to new geographies and types of physics modeling.

**Our stack:** A monorepo-style build system and automated CI/CD; multi-cloud infrastructure managed as code; containerized services and workflow orchestration across Kubernetes and HPC batch compute; and full metrics and error-tracking observability. We care more that you’ve run systems like these than which specific tools you’ve used.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Build and operate production pipelines** for physics simulation, digital-twin generation, and ML inference, with orchestration, monitoring, and alerting.
* **Own reliability**: debug failures across APIs, preprocessing, modeling, and downstream consumers, and drive uptime and throughput improvements.
* **Support ML in production:** partner with MLEs to run their data pipelines, GPU training and inference jobs, and model monitoring on the platform.
* **Build geospatial pipelines** that merge heterogeneous spatial datasets (imagery, LiDAR, property information, terrain, weather) into reproducible, production-grade workflows.
* **Run simulation workloads at scale**: schedule and optimize solver jobs on cluster compute, and track compute cost and utilization.
* **Strengthen CI/CD and infrastructure**: infrastructure-as-code, containerization, automated testing, and release processes across simulation, digital-twin, and ML codebases.
* **Extend the platform to new perils and geographies**: adapt data ingestion, digital-twin generation, and simulation workflows as Stand expands.
* **Work directly with SMEs, simulation engineers, and MLEs** to scope requirements and ship tooling they use daily.

**Core Skills (Must-Haves):**

* **3+ years building production-grade data, simulation, or modeling pipelines** with end-to-end automation, monitoring, and alerting.
* **Strong software engineering foundation**, with tested, maintainable, shared code.
* **DevOps ownership**: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, containers, CI/CD, observability, and incident response for systems you run.
* **Running batch compute at scale:** you've operated long-running, resource-heavy jobs as multi-step workflows, on an HPC scheduler or Kubernetes, and you know how they fail: queueing, preemption, partial reruns, and moving large inputs and outputs.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**About Mavria**
----------------

Mavria’s mission is to **build the industrial capacity America needs to lead in AI.** We believe that sustaining America’s AI leadership requires an unprecedented expansion of power, manufacturing, supply chains and physical infrastructure.

Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who met at the U.S. Department of Energy, working on some of the country’s hardest energy and infrastructure projects. There, they saw a widening gap: AI labs and cloud providers were racing to scale compute, while the infrastructure underneath them was still built one custom project at a time, on timelines measured in years.

We founded Mavria to close that gap. We are building to **industrialize intelligence**: turning the physical infrastructure AI runs on into products we manufacture, deploy and improve with every build.

We’re starting with data centers. Our first product, Terrain, is a factory-built data center platform. Terrain 01 is being built in Houston now, and we’ve raised $130M as of October 2026 to accelerate our roadmap.

Terrain is our first product, not the limit of our ambition. We intend to eliminate the physical bottlenecks that constrain American AI leadership and build one of the foundational infrastructure companies of the AI era.

**How we build**
----------------

At Mavria, three principles guide how we work:

* **Ambition**: We want to build a generational company. To do that, we build capabilities, not just products. Terrain is our first product, not our last – and we seek to eliminate strategic bottlenecks across the entire AI supply chain.
* **Urgency**: AI moves in weeks, while infrastructure tends to move in years. We match the frontier’s pace by making decisions quickly, building in parallel and securing critical supply ahead of demand. We surface problems early and never compromise on safety or engineering rigor.
* **Ownership**: When we say we’ll do something, we do it. Keeping our word is how we stand apart, and taking radical ownership over our scope and our domain is how we build trust – internally and externally – while moving fast.

**Role scope**
==============

This is a horizontal data position embedded in our engineering and manufacturing teams. You’ll work side by side with those teams to learn how they design and build Terrain, then build the internal tools that make them faster. You’ll own each tool end to end, from the data pipelines underneath to the apps our engineers use every day, with one goal: 10x the productivity of the teams you support. You will:

* **Embed with the teams**: Sit with our engineers and manufacturing leads, earn their trust and learn their workflows well enough to see where software can remove bottlenecks.
* **Build the data foundation**: Design and run the pipelines that bring together data from CAD, PLM, ERP, suppliers and spreadsheets into clean, reliable models our tools can build on.
* **Automate design work**: Build configurators and generators that turn engineering rules into BOMs, layouts and documentation, so our engineers spend their time on engineering.
* **Streamline supply chain and procurement**: Build tools that track suppliers, lead times, costs and inventory, so we can secure critical supply ahead of demand.
* **Build with AI**: Use LLMs, agents and AI coding tools to ship quickly, and put AI assistants into our engineers’ daily work where they save the most time.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

We are looking for hands-on builders with experience across **data science**, **data engineering** and **product engineering** who can be:

* **A builder**: You’ve shipped tools end to end, from data pipeline to user interface, and people relied on them.
* **A partner**: You build rapport quickly, listen closely and turn a messy workflow into a clear spec.
* **AI-native**: You build with LLMs and AI coding tools every day and know where they help and where they don’t.
* **Full-stack with data**: You’re fluent in SQL and Python, comfortable with the AWS console, git, the command line, and with modern data stack tools (e.g. dbt or Airflow), and can stand up a web app when the job calls for it.
* **An owner**: You move fast, own outcomes and measure your work by the hours it saves the people who use it.
* **Technically curious**: AI, energy, manufacturing and infrastructure energize you, and you want to learn how hardware gets designed and built.

Experience at early-stage startups, on internal tools or platform teams, or in forward-deployed or solutions engineering roles is especially relevant. We value ability over years or titles.

**To apply:** Share your background, a link to your GitHub or portfolio, and a short note on a problem you solved by building a tool for someone else.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive total compensation package
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance is 100% paid for the employee
* Retirement Plan with a 3.5% company match
* Flexible time off

Mavria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Mavria will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law.

**Company Description**

**Who we are**

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.

Come join us!

**ServiceNow**

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

 **Job Description**

**The Role**

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This is not an ML role. This is a **distributed systems engineering** role at the heart of the agentic AI wave.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* **Agent orchestration engine** — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
* **Distributed session management** — Lease-based ownership using DynamoDB conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
* **Event-driven message pipeline** — SQS FIFO queues for ordered delivery, Kafka consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
* **Structured concurrency** — Python asyncio TaskGroups running multiple concurrent tasks per session (message polling, lease heartbeats, output publishing, orchestrator execution) with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
* **Observability infrastructure** — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
* **Caching and state layers** — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

  
**Qualifications**

**You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:**

* Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
* Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
* Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
* Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
* Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
* gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

**Required:**

* Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)

jobs.description:
**About E2B**
=============

E2B is a fast-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish.

**About the role**
==================

E2B has started billions of Firecracker sandboxes across regions on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure. Every sandbox is a real virtual machine that has to start in well under a second, resume from a snapshot on a different host, and share a host with up to about 200 others without noticing them.

Your job will be to build and own the Go service on every host that creates, pauses, resumes and tears down sandboxes, along with the Linux underneath it: host networking, memory and isolation. You'll work closely with our sandbox team in Prague, who own the Firecracker runtime, the guest kernel, sandbox storage and live migration, and with our infrastructure engineers, who put the platform together.

We're hiring more than one engineer into this role, each with a different focus: some go deepest on Linux and how sandboxes run on the host, others on sandbox networking. Our runtime is open source at github.com/e2b-dev/runtime, and the sandbox package is a good place to see what you'd work on.

Responsibilities include:

* Making sandboxes start fast and keeping them fast as the fleet grows to millions and later billions of sandboxes, with starts under 200ms
* Evolving the architecture of the software that runs sandboxes on every host, so it can change without disrupting them
* Making the sandbox lifecycle reliable under failure, so no sandbox is leaked or lost when a process or host dies
* Keeping the host OS and kernel current across the fleet, rolling out upgrades without disrupting running sandboxes
* Building the sandbox network: isolation, egress control and addressing for untrusted workloads
* Enforcing resource isolation between sandboxes on shared hosts, so every sandbox gets the CPU, memory and I/O it was allocated
* Building host-level observability, so we understand what every sandbox costs the host it runs on
* Being on call for the platform you build, alongside the rest of the platform team

This role requires a high amount of ownership. You'll write the code and the design docs for the hardest changes in your area, and ship every day.

If you aren't afraid of going deep into the Linux kernel when a problem needs it, and words like eBPF, cgroups, network namespaces, nftables, conntrack, or noisy neighbor problem sound exciting to you, we want to hear from you!

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* Experience building and operating systems software across a large production fleet: node agents, container or VM runtimes, schedulers, or similar
* Strong Go, or strong Rust or C/C++ and the willingness to pick up Go quickly; our services are in Go
* Deep Linux knowledge: processes, CPU scheduling, memory management, cgroups and namespaces, and the network stack
* Experience making software correct under failure: crash recovery, reconciling recorded state with what is actually running, and cleanup when a process or host dies
* For a networking focus: Linux networking for multi-tenant workloads, such as network namespaces, virtual interfaces, iptables/nftables and egress control
* A performance mindset: you've shaved milliseconds off hot paths, profiled production systems under load, and treat p99 as a number you own
* Excited to work in person from San Francisco
* Comfortable with our code and infrastructure being public

We expect this experience will often come from around five or more years of relevant work, but the depth of what you've built matters more than a specific number.

**Bonus points for:**
=====================

* Experience with VM or container runtimes such as Firecracker, KVM, gVisor or runc, including memory management and snapshot and restore
* GPU or accelerator infrastructure, passthrough or GPU-as-a-service
* Kernel tracing and eBPF tooling
* OS-level hardening, such as seccomp and Linux security modules

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**About E2B**
=============

E2B is a fast-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish.

**About the role**
==================

E2B has started billions of Firecracker sandboxes across regions on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure, and single customers now ask for 100,000 of them running at once. The control plane behind that is a set of Go services backed by Postgres and Redis, deployed on Kubernetes and managed through GitOps.

Your job will be to own how the platform fits together: the API and the proxy layer that routes traffic to sandboxes, our Kubernetes infrastructure across clouds and regions, and the infrastructure that makes every region and cloud run the same code. You'll work closely with our systems engineers, who own Linux, the software that runs sandboxes on each host, and sandbox networking, and with the engineers building the product on top of the control plane.

Our runtime is open source at github.com/e2b-dev/runtime, and the api service and the proxy are good places to see what you'd work on.

Responsibilities include:

* Designing and building Go services and APIs: new endpoints, gRPC and OpenAPI contracts, and the data models behind them
* Building and evolving the edge proxy and the routing state behind it, so traffic stays correct as sandboxes pause, resume and move between hosts
* Scaling the API and the Redis and Postgres behind it to hundreds of thousands of concurrent sandboxes per region: query and schema design, caching, sharding and migrations under load
* Writing the Kubernetes automation that scales the platform with demand: provisioning capacity ahead of load spikes and draining long-lived nodes without disrupting running sandboxes
* Implementing placement across machine families and CPU generations on multiple clouds, so a resumed sandbox always lands on a host that can restore it
* Building the Terraform modules, Helm charts and Argo CD configuration that make a new region or cloud fast and repeatable to stand up
* Building the metrics, tracing and alerting for the services you own
* Making sure self-hosted and enterprise deployments run what we run (we're open source)
* Being on call for the platform you build, alongside the rest of the platform team

This role requires a high amount of ownership. You'll write the code and the design docs for the hardest changes in your area, and ship every day.

If words like control plane, Kubernetes, L7 routing, GitOps, gRPC contracts, or multi-region sound exciting to you, we want to hear from you!

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* Experience owning a large-scale distributed system end to end: building it, running it in production across regions, and being the person called when it breaks
* Strong Go: you build services and ship fixes in services you did not write
* Experience operating large-scale Kubernetes clusters in production, including controllers, operators and node lifecycle management
* Infrastructure as code and GitOps, for example Terraform and Argo CD, with deep experience on at least one of GCP, AWS or Azure; we run on all three, and you don't need to know them all
* API and data design: service contracts and Postgres data models (gRPC, OpenAPI) that stay backward compatible, with schema changes and migrations under load on a primary that cannot go down
* Solid Linux and networking fundamentals: enough to debug a host under load and reason about L4/L7 traffic, load balancing and connection draining
* Excited to work in person from San Francisco
* Comfortable with our code and infrastructure being public

We expect this experience will often come from around five or more years of relevant work, but the depth of what you've built matters more than a specific number.

**Bonus points for:**
=====================

* Building reliable distributed APIs: idempotency, leases and backpressure
* Multi-account cloud organizations, such as AWS Organizations and GCP folder hierarchies
* Shipping infrastructure that customers run themselves
* Familiarity with Firecracker, KVM or how VM workloads behave on shared hosts
* Contributions to Kubernetes or other CNCF projects

**What it’s like to work at E2B**
=================================

We’re a fast-growing startup with in-person (4 days on-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 9-figure revenue and work directly with top-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI.

We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in-office employees.

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  
  
We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  
  
At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  
  
**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).**

**Summary**

As a Software Engineer, Embedded Systems / Firmware, you'll work at the intersection of software and hardware to build and maintain the low-level platform stack that powers Rivet's body-worn and field-deployed devices — including our AR/XR soldier systems, which combine real-time sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, depth sensors) with a display and compute pipeline running on embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments. You'll focus on the kernel, BSP, HALs, drivers, and board bring-up that make that pipeline reliable, secure, performant, and power-efficient enough to run all day on a warfighter's body.  
  
You'll work closely with hardware, electrical, and sensor-fusion/AR software engineers to integrate new hardware, debug issues across the full system stack, and deliver platform software/firmware that holds up under the SWaP, thermal, and ruggedization constraints of field-deployed defense hardware. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership over meaningful pieces of the platform.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain system-level software/firmware for power- and thermally-constrained, body-worn embedded devices across embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments, with a focus on the kernel, BSP, HALs, and device drivers.
* Bring up new hardware and peripherals, working closely with electrical and hardware engineers to debug issues across the hardware/software boundary.
* Debug complex issues involving hardware, kernel, drivers, boot processes, power management, memory, and system performance — with power and thermal efficiency treated as first-class constraints given our SWaP requirements.
* Develop automated tests for system-level software, including hardware-in-the-loop validation**.**
* Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform bring-up activities.

**Requirements**

* BSin CS/CE/EE, or equivalent industry experience.
* 3+ years of experience developing system-level software/firmware for embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
* Experience developing embedded software/firmware for ARM-based SoCs, MPUs, or MCUs in systems with multiple interconnected processors.
* Experience developing and integrating low-level device drivers, interfacing with custom hardware and peripherals, and bringing up new hardware.
* Strong C/C++ programming skills and familiarity with low-level debugging and development tools such as JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
* Experience with common hardware interfaces and protocols such as USB, MIPI, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, and PCIe.
* Ability to diagnose complex system-level issues using logs, traces, debuggers, and hardware instrumentation.
* Familiarity with embedded software test automation and hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) or system integration testing
* Comfortable working cross-functionally in a highly collaborative environment with engineers across software, electrical, mechanical, and systems disciplines.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, if required for the role.

**Preferred Qualifications**

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms Foundational Services (IPFS) SRE organization, you use code and infrastructure automation to configure, maintain, monitor, and optimize the platforms and services in your scope. You solve complex, broad reliability problems with simple, straightforward solutions and help apply service level indicators (SLIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) to resolve issues before they impact customers. **About Mistral**
-----------------

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

As a Research Engineer on the RL Systems team, you will help build the agentic platform we use to train and evaluate our models. Orchestral is the system our researchers rely on to run training and evaluation at scale — from the rollout engine that powers agentic workflows to the infrastructure that keeps their workloads running reliably. What you build becomes the foundation the whole science team works on.

Your work will span the platform's core: the library, tooling, abstractions and rollout engine — including new capabilities like long-running tasks, subagents and RL features — and the machinery that runs data and jobs at scale, with a focus on resiliency, routing and request handling. You will own significant pieces end to end, from design to production.

This is a software engineering role rather than an ML or infrastructure-operations one: RL or PyTorch experience is not required, and you will spend your time building the platform, not operating it. You will be building a distributed RL system, with the scientists as your users.

  

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Design and build the core of the Orchestral platform: the library, abstractions and tooling researchers use to train and evaluate models.
* Build and evolve the rollout engine, shipping new capabilities such as long-running tasks and subagents.
* Run Orchestral as a production system: keep training and evaluation workloads reliable at scale.
* Improve how data and jobs flow through the platform as usage grows — scheduling, routing and request handling.
* Treat researchers as your users: understand their workflows and turn recurring needs into robust, shared tooling.
* Raise the bar on engineering quality across the platform: testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and documentation.
* Contribute to open-source rollout-engine and agent-infrastructure projects where it benefits the platform.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* Experience directly building and debugging complex distributed systems at scale, with an emphasis on reliability and scalability.
* Strong Python skills and solid software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.
* A builder mindset: you have constructed systems from the ground up, not just operated polished ones.
* A track record in small teams running complex systems at scale — for example in finance, crypto or ad tech.
* Self-starter, low-ego and collaborative, with a product mindset toward your users.
* Curiosity about ML and RL — this experience is not required, but a desire to learn is.

**Nice-to-haves**
-----------------

* Hands-on experience with Ray or similar distributed-computing frameworks.
* Open-source contributions, especially to rollout-engine or agent-infrastructure projects such as SLIME, verl or PrimeRL.
* Experience building or working with agentic workflows and environments.

**What We Offer**

Join a small engineering team building a healthcare workflow automation platform. You will own major parts of the system, from agents that create and repair automations to the customer platform and cloud infrastructure that runs them reliably.

### **What You'll Do**

* Improve agents that build and maintain automations using browser automation tools.
* Scale worker orchestration, job queues, and real-time coordination for growing workloads.
* Build APIs, SDKs, and observability tools that help customers understand and resolve automation failures.
* Ship features across the frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure based on customer feedback.
* Set engineering standards and help shape how the team builds as it grows.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of experience in engineering roles and proficiency in full-stack development.
* Experience shipping and operating production software, including ownership of systems through incidents and on-call issues.
* Proficiency with AWS and comfort working across application code and production cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with distributed systems; healthcare data and browser automation experience are also relevant.
* Sound technical judgment and the ability to take ambiguous problems from concept through delivery.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary is $180,000 to $240,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, United States.

Compensation Range: $180K - $240K

jobs.title: Software Engineering 5 - Ads Finance
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Since launching our ad-supported tier in 2022, the momentum has been unstoppable—we reach over 94 million global monthly active users! As we enter our fourth year , our ambition is massive, and we are just getting started.

  

**Our Team**

  

The Ads Platform Engineering creates the ecosystem that spans across the “Pitch to Pay” process. It goes all the way from enabling our sales teams (and other DSPs, resellers) to engage advertisers to run their campaigns on Netflix, and cuts across inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience onboarding, targeting and delivery, measurement, reporting and finance.

  
  

The **Ads Finance** team builds the ads billing and invoicing system that enable the ads platform to operate as a transaction sub-ledger

  
  

Our team is new, yet we have enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

  
  

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

  
  

**Skills & experience we’re seeking:**

  

* Professional experience and interest in revenue advertising solutions, preferably on the sell-side or platform side.
* Understand the modern ad technology ecosystem with a focus on fintech.
* Experience with privacy, compliance, and governance in the advertising space.
* 3+ years of hands-on, software engineering experience in building business-critical, reliable, and distributed systems.
* Background in building financial or payment solutions. Experience in leveraging ML is a plus.
* Proven expertise in developing workflows for revenue recognition, invoicing, and report exchanges with DSPs, with a strong ability to manage financial transactions and revenue tracking in the advertising domain.
* Strong understanding of data governance principles for finance data, with experience in building robust, scalable, and secure systems for handling financial data, processing transactions, and generating accurate bills.
* In-depth knowledge of finance compliance, including audit and SOX requirements, ensuring accurate billing and strict adherence to regulatory standards.
* Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.
* Developed many cloud-based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object-oriented),
* Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  

  

**Nice to haves:**

* Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.
* Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints
  

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $388,000.00 - $558,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Join Apple's wireless connectivity software engineering organization and help develop the Bluetooth MAC layer and Thread software that runs on custom silicon like Apple N1 and ships in nearly every Apple product. We're looking for a highly motivated embedded software engineer to help turn new ideas into wireless features that make Apple products work better together.

Our team develops the Bluetooth MAC layer and Thread software that runs on custom silicon like Apple N1, H2, and S11 and ultimately powers wireless connectivity across nearly every Apple product. Apple's vertical integration and ecosystem scale let us build wireless features that ship to hundreds of millions of devices and shape the connectivity experience our customers rely on every day. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of embedded software development experience
* Strong proficiency in C programming
* Experience designing and developing embedded software for real-time operation on ARM processors
* Working knowledge of Bluetooth/Thread protocols and standard

* Excellent analytical and debugging skills, including experience with debuggers and protocol analyzers
* Experience with chip/platform bring-up
* Proven track record of shipping consumer products

* Passion for solving complex engineering challenges and delivering exceptional user experience

jobs.description:
**Overview**
============

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

*Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.*

*Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.*

**Job Description:**
====================

**What we're building**
=======================

We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start.

Baker Tilly is the sixth-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how.

As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the screens practitioners use and the services behind them. You'll take well-scoped features from frontend to production and learn from experienced engineers as you go.

**What you'll work with**
=========================

* Years of client engagement history, tax returns, and financial records, at the scale of a major firm.
* Tax, audit, and advisory practitioners who help define what good looks like and review what the agents produce.
* Real users inside the firm who give direct feedback on what you build.
* We work in partnership with frontier labs.
* A mix of building and buying. You'll help decide which is which, and everything we ship meets the same standards for security, tracing, and testing.
* Our stack: Python, TypeScript and React, Databricks, graph and vector databases, MCP, OpenTelemetry, and Braintrust, on Azure.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Build features for our AI agents end to end: the screens practitioners use, the services behind them, and the data they read.
* Build the tools our experts use to review agent output and flag what's wrong.
* Work directly with practitioners to understand how they do their jobs, then turn that into software.
* Connect to firm systems and data through APIs, with the right access controls.
* Write tested, readable code. Review other people's code, and have yours reviewed.
* Watch what you ship: tests, tracing, user feedback, and fixing what breaks.
* Use AI coding tools extensively to build and ship, and check their work. We ship through a code factory more and more, and you'll help us get there.

**Who you are**
===============

* You're a hands-on technologist who has built things people actually use, ideally end to end, from the first conversation with users through production and after.
* You're naturally curious, a strong problem solver, and a clear communicator.
* You can take an objective, form an opinion, and move things forward on your own, even when the path is unclear.

**What you bring**
==================

* 5 years of experience preferred building and shipping production software, on both frontend and backend.
* You use AI coding tools extensively, and you have opinions about what works.
* TypeScript or JavaScript with a modern frontend framework, plus a backend language like Python, Node, Go, or Java.
* Comfort with APIs, relational databases, and common authentication patterns.
* Solid habits: debugging, automated tests, version control, secure coding.
* You ask who should see the data before you ask how to show it.
* Bachelor's Degree required

**Nice to have**
================

* React, Python, PostgreSQL, Azure, Databricks, containers, or CI/CD tooling.
* Some exposure to LLM apps, retrieval, agents, or evals. No AI background needed.
* Experience with enterprise systems, specialist business users, or regulated data.

**In a year**
=============

* You've shipped features practitioners use ever

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, General
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

This is our open application for founding members who want to work on the hardest problems in AI inference. Apply here if you aren't sure which of our roles fits you, if the role you'd want doesn't exist yet, or if your work spans several disciplines.

You'll work closely with our researchers and engineers to identify where you can make the biggest contribution, whether that's developing new research ideas, building core systems, or bringing advances in inference into production.

**About you**
-------------

* You have a track record of taking ambiguous technical problems from zero to shipped results, in research, systems, or production
* You go where the leverage is, moving between models, systems, kernels, and infrastructure rather than staying in one layer
* You would rather own an outcome end to end than a single component, and you pick up new domains quickly
* You are drawn to the risk and upside of an early-stage startup
* You embrace ambiguity and have a strong bias for action
* You operate with a tech-lead mentality regardless of title or years of experience
* You treat AI as a force multiplier: fluent with coding agents and modern AI/ML workflows, you fold them into how you ship, and you are willing to push the boundary of what’s possible with agents

Requirements

* Exceptional depth in at least one area of AI inference: model research and post-training, quantization or speculative decoding, GPU kernels, serving systems and runtimes, or large-scale distributed infrastructure
* Working knowledge of modern LLM and multimodal architectures and the performance tradeoffs behind them
* A track record of shipping technical work others depend on, through publications in relevant venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, MLSys, ...), open-source contributions, or production systems
* Production proficiency in Python and at least one systems language: Rust, C++, or Go

Bonus

* Hands-on experience with open-source inference and serving stacks such as PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, Dynamo, SMG, and TensorRT-LLM
* Hands-on experience authoring GPU kernels with CUDA, Triton, or PTX
* Experience with quantization (NVFP4, FP8, PTQ, QAT, QAD) or speculative decoding (DFlash, EAGLE-3)
* Familiarity with system-wide profiling, tracing, and debugging using tools such as Nsight Systems (nsys)
* Experience with on-device inference or accelerators beyond NVIDIA and AMD
* A track record of operating inference workloads across 1,000+ GPUs
* Contributions to open-source ML or systems infrastructure

Compensation & Benefits

* Highly competitive salary and equity
* Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents
* Strong 401(k) match
* Meals and snacks on us + discretionary productivity budget

*Strong preference for in-person in Palo Alto or Brooklyn.*

**About Inco**
==============

Inco AI (inco.ai) builds the agent-native inference platform for tomorrow’s token economics, making advanced AI fast enough for real workflows and affordable enough to use at scale. We’re the researchers and engineers behind AWQ, DFlash, and TensorRT-LLM, bringing frontier research into production.

Our platform ranked #1 in output speed on Artificial Analysis for every model we launched with, and our DFlash models have surpassed 10 million downloads on Hugging Face. Backed by B Capital, E14 Fund, and Tectonic Ventures, we serve customers across serverless, dedicated, and local AI deployments.

Compensation Range: $200K - $350K

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Mavria**
----------------

Mavria’s mission is to **build the industrial capacity America needs to lead in AI.** We believe that sustaining America’s AI leadership requires an unprecedented expansion of power, manufacturing, supply chains and physical infrastructure.

Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who met at the U.S. Department of Energy, working on some of the country’s hardest energy and infrastructure projects. There, they saw a widening gap: AI labs and cloud providers were racing to scale compute, while the infrastructure underneath them was still built one custom project at a time, on timelines measured in years.

We founded Mavria to close that gap. We are building to **industrialize intelligence**: turning the physical infrastructure AI runs on into products we manufacture, deploy and improve with every build.

We’re starting with data centers. Our first product, Terrain, is a factory-built data center platform. Terrain 01 is being built in Houston now, and we’ve raised $130M as of October 2026 to accelerate our roadmap.

Terrain is our first product, not the limit of our ambition. We intend to eliminate the physical bottlenecks that constrain American AI leadership and build one of the foundational infrastructure companies of the AI era.

**How we build**
----------------

At Mavria, three principles guide how we work:

* **Ambition**: We want to build a generational company. To do that, we build capabilities, not just products. Terrain is our first product, not our last – and we seek to eliminate strategic bottlenecks across the entire AI supply chain.
* **Urgency**: AI moves in weeks, while infrastructure tends to move in years. We match the frontier’s pace by making decisions quickly, building in parallel and securing critical supply ahead of demand. We surface problems early and never compromise on safety or engineering rigor.
* **Ownership**: When we say we’ll do something, we do it. Keeping our word is how we stand apart, and taking radical ownership over our scope and our domain is how we build trust – internally and externally – while moving fast.

**Role scope**
==============

As our first forward-deployed engineer, you’ll be the technical lead on Mavria’s customer pursuits, working side by side with our co-founder Seth Cohen. You’ll sit with frontier labs, neoclouds and developers, learn what it takes to bring their compute online, and show them how our Terrain product gets them there.

* **Lead technical discovery**: Work through a customer’s site, power, cooling and schedule to define what a Terrain deployment looks like for them.
* **Drive sales enablement**: Embed deeply with our engineering team in Houston to build and own the decks, technical briefs and demos our commercial team sells with, so every claim matches what we’re building.
* **Design the solution**: Turn customer needs into deployment concepts, technical proposals and RFP responses our commercial team can close on.
* **Be the voice of the customer**: Bring what you learn in the field back to engineering and manufacturing, so every deployment shapes the next product.
* **Carry it through**: Stay with each customer from first conversation to signed deal and into deployment, so nothing gets lost at the handoff.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

For this role, we’re interested in an established forward-deployed or deployments professional with the following qualities:

* **An engineer first**: You have a background in data centers, power, electrical or mechanical systems, and you can go deep with a customer’s engineering team.
* **Customer-facing**: You’re as comfortable in a boardroom as on a job site, and you can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and executives alike.
* **A problem-finder**: You start with open questions and work out what the customer needs, not only what they asked for.
* **An owner**: You run with little direction and take responsibility for outcomes.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Platform
jobs.description:
**About E2B**
=============

E2B is a fast-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish.

**About the role**
==================

E2B has started billions of Firecracker sandboxes across regions on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure, for customers whose products stop when our sandboxes do. Reliability here is an engineering problem: the fixes for our hardest incidents land in code, not in configuration.

Your job will be to build the reliability of the platform: defining what healthy means, building the observability and automation that keep it there, and making new capabilities work reliably in production. You'll work closely with our infrastructure and systems engineers, who build the platform, and with our sandbox team in Prague.

Responsibilities include:

* Defining SLOs and error budgets for the platform's core paths, such as sandbox start, resume and connect, and making them part of how we alert, release and prioritize
* Building the observability and alerting that tells us the platform is healthy before customers do
* Taking new platform capabilities from first release to working reliably in production
* Building the automation that removes operational work, from release checks to routine fleet operations
* Building the security and trust layers the platform's reliability depends on, such as service-to-service mutual TLS
* Making our private cloud and enterprise deployments as reliable as our own regions
* Running incident response, and improving how we handle incidents so a class of failure does not come back
* Being on call, and helping shape the rotation for the rest of the platform team

This role requires a high amount of ownership. You'll write the code and the design docs for the hardest changes in your area, and ship every day.

If words like SLOs, error budgets, eBPF, Kubernetes, multi-region, or noisy neighbor problem sound exciting rather than scary, we want to hear from you!

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* Experience operating large-scale distributed systems in production across regions, and making their reliability measurable
* Strong Go (Rust or C/C++ also welcome): you take ownership of the services you build and proactively fix issues across the codebase, including in services you didn't originally write
* Reliability engineering: you've defined SLOs and error budgets for a production service and held the platform to them
* Incident response: you've been on call, fixed what paged you, and written post-incident reviews that led to lasting fixes
* Experience operating Kubernetes in production
* Infrastructure as code and GitOps, for example Terraform and Argo CD, with deep experience on at least one of GCP, AWS or Azure; we run on all three, and you don't need to know them all
* Solid Linux and networking fundamentals: enough to debug a host under load and reason about DNS, TCP and L4/L7 load balancing
* Operating relational databases and caches in production, including performance diagnosis
* Excited to work in person from San Francisco
* Comfortable with our code and infrastructure being public

We expect this experience will often come from around five or more years of relevant work, but the depth of what you've built matters more than a specific number.

**Bonus points for:**
=====================

* Running observability pipelines at scale, for example Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry
* Kernel tracing and eBPF tooling
* Capacity planning and cost efficiency across clouds
* Chaos engineering or deterministic simulation testing
* Familiarity with Firecracker, KVM or how VM workloads behave on shared hosts
* Contributions to CNCF or similar open source projects

**What it’s like to work at E2B**
=================================

We’re a fast-growing startup with in-person (4 days on-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 9-figure revenue and work directly with top-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI.

We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in-office employees.

Compensation Range: $250K - $350K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Deployments
jobs.description:
**ABOUT TITAN**

Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7.

We've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 800+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT.

Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

Customer Deployments is Titan's central AI deployment team. We sit at the holding company level and partner with our MSPs to bring applied AI into production for the businesses they serve. Those clients span every industry: private equity, venture and hedge funds, family offices, biotech and pharma, insurance, accounting firms, healthcare, manufacturing, law. Inside each one we work across functions like finance, investor relations, compliance, operations, HR and client service. Working alongside the MSP that already supports each client means every deployment fits how the business runs, and has a team behind it long after launch.

Most companies know AI should change how they work. Very few have someone who can walk in, learn the business in a week, find the work that matters, and ship something people actually use. That's this team.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Forward Deployed Engineers on Customer Deployments own a deployment end to end. You'll sit with a client's leadership and the people doing the work, learn how their business really runs, find where AI changes the outcome, design the solution, build it, ship it to production, and stay until it's adopted. One month you might be working with a private equity firm to build AI into its value creation plan and deploy it across its portfolio companies; the next, learning how a biotech runs its regulatory submissions or how an insurer handles claims intake.

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role for someone who is part architect, part engineer and part operator. You build with agentic coding tools and move fast, but your edge is judgment: which problem to solve, how to make an agent safe and reliable, and when it's ready for users. What you learn in the field shapes Titan's platform, and the patterns you build become the playbook for every deployment after yours.

**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL**

* Get up to speed quickly on a new business and its workflows, sit with the people doing the work, and find the highest-leverage opportunities for AI
* Architect solutions across models, agents, data and integrations, and decide when an off-the-shelf platform beats a custom build
* Build with agentic coding tools: prototype in days and ship to production in weeks, connected to the systems clients run (CRMs, ERPs, fund admin and portfolio systems, document stores, data warehouses, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace)
* Put agents into production properly, with guardrails, evals, observability, human review where it matters, and the access controls and documentation regulated clients expect
* Lead onboarding, training and change management so deployments get used, and measure their impact against a baseline
* Be the technical voice in front of executives: explain tradeoffs, push back on weak use cases, and earn the next project
* Turn what works into reusable components, templates, evals and playbooks, and bring what you learn in the field back to Product and Engineering
* Partner with MSP leadership to find and shape new deployment opportunities across their client base

**YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU**

* Love learning how businesses work: you can get up to speed on a PE fund's deal process, an insurer's underwriting workflow or an accounting firm's close in days, and talk about it credibly with the people who run it
* Bring 5+ years in solutions architecture, forward deployed engineering, technical consulting or software engineering, with significant customer-facing work
* Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar) as your daily way of building, and write solid Python or TypeScript
* Have a solid grounding in applied AI: you've built LLM-powered tools, agents or workflows, and you understand what it takes to run them reliably in production (evals, guardrails, failure modes, cost and latency)
* Can run a room with a business leader, turn a vague ambition into a concrete scope, and say no to the wrong project
* Thrive in ambiguity: a new industry, a new stack and a new set of stakeholders every few months sounds fun to you
* Would rather put a working system in front of 10 users in three weeks than a perfect one in front of none in three months
* Take extreme ownership of outcomes and treat client data with a security mindset

**BONUS**

* Have shipped LLM agents to production for real users, with evals and guardrails you designed
* Forward deployed, solutions or software engineering experience at an AI, SaaS or consulting company
* Domain depth in financial services (PE, VC, hedge funds, family offices), life sciences, insurance or professional services
* Experience in or alongside MSPs and IT services

**LOGISTICS**

* Location: New York City or San Francisco
* Travel: Up to 25%, for on-site discovery, launches and client workshops
* Compensation: $150,000–$250,000 base + generous equity package

jobs.title: Research Engineer, PAR Safety - Meta Superintelligence Labs
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking Research Engineers to join the Data & Privacy Research team within Meta Superintelligence Labs. This team studies, evaluates and aligns Meta's frontier AI model and systems, with a focus on memorization & privacy risks. We ensure that our frontier models and agents operate and behave within users' privacy and Meta's privacy expectations by rigorously measuring and mitigating across the entire frontier model development lifecycle - pre-training data curation to post-training alignment. As a Research Engineer on this team, you will work alongside AI researchers to develop new evaluations grounded in real-world threat models, maintain existing evaluations so they remain current and reliable, and produce written artifacts that Meta can trust during high-stakes launches. This is a highly technical role requiring the ability to deeply understand frontier LLM behavior, hypothesize and design true and grounded risk vectors and turn them into automated evaluations with high scalability and reliability. The evaluations you build will directly inform risk assessments and launch decisions within Meta Superintelligence Labs, making engineering reliability, rigor, and scalability paramount. You will succeed by delivering iteratively while re-prioritizing work based on evolving research needs and launch timelines as we advance the technical research frontier. The evaluations you produce will significantly influence pre-training data mixes, model behavior during post-training and will be read and acted upon by Meta's leadership during model launches and policy reviews.  
  
  

### **Research Engineer, PAR Safety - Meta Superintelligence Labs Responsibilities:**

* Build and continuously refine evaluations for multimodal and agentic frontier AI models across pretraining and post-training

* Scope and deliver end-to-end evaluations under ambiguous and rapidly shifting requirements, re-prioritizing as the threat landscape and Meta’s frontier models evolve

* Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks
